answer: Whisper relay stops bulk fakes. A beacon whisper travels a relay chain one hop per epoch, glacier-slow. Each identity holds one shale-marked hop and must echo the whisper onward by dawn. A missed or copied echo burns the hop bond; auditors replay the chain to expose rented hops. Staffing 1,000 hops costs 1,000 answers at 60: 60,000 chasing a 40,000 pool, a 20,000 loss. An honest agent answers one echo and pays 60 once, keeping its share.
